questions.question: The Unified Payments Interface (UPI), which allows instant 24x7 bank-to-bank money transfer through a single mobile app, was developed by which organisation?

options.C: Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI)
options.D: National Bank for Agriculture and Rural Development (NABARD)

questions.solution:
✅ Correct answer: B – National Payments Corporation of India (NPCI)

UPI is a real-time payment system built and operated by NPCI. Users send or receive money instantly, 24x7 – even on bank holidays, using a Virtual Payment Address (VPA) such as name@bank, without sharing bank account details. Every payment is approved with a secret UPI PIN.

📌 Key pointers

  • NPCI is the umbrella organisation for retail payments in India – set up in 2008 by the RBI with the support of the Indian Banks' Association (IBA).
  • It is a not-for-profit company (Section 8, Companies Act 2013) with its headquarters in Mumbai.
  • UPI was launched in 2016; the BHIM app (NPCI's own UPI app) followed in December 2016.
  • UPI 123PAY lets feature-phone users make UPI payments without internet.

🧠 Why not the other options?

  • RBI – the regulator of payment systems (Payment and Settlement Systems Act, 2007). It promoted NPCI but did not build UPI itself.
  • SEBI – regulates the securities (share) market, not payments.
  • NABARD – apex development bank for agriculture and rural development.
  • IBA – an association of banks; it supported the creation of NPCI but does not run UPI.
